Suppression or gating of a representation, response, action, or retrieval process.
Resource expenditure or experienced exertion associated with maintaining control against difficulty, fatigue, or conflict.
Continued maintenance of a goal, intention, or action policy over time despite competing influences.
Goal-directed control emphasizing internally maintained intention and action selection; it does not imply causally unconditioned freedom.
The experienced sense that one is initiating or controlling an action or outcome.
A rule or probability distribution mapping represented states to actions or control updates.
Persistence of a policy across perturbation or time under a declared metric.
Update of an action policy in response to evidence, prediction error, consequences, or changed goals.
A representation of an expected future observation, state, or outcome under a model.
A predictive belief or distribution over possible future states or observations.
The temporal extent over which a prediction model explicitly represents future possibilities.
A represented alternative state or trajectory evaluated despite not being the currently realized history.
Internal generation or evaluation of alternative possible trajectories.
An action possibility represented relative to an agent capacities and environment.
An ordered organization of intermediate goals or actions intended to reach a target state.
Construction or evaluation of plans before or during action.
Change in valuation as a function of delay to an outcome.
Discrepancy between target and current controlled variable under a feedback model.
Detection or estimation of competition among responses, goals, values, or predictions.
Processes coordinating goals, working memory, inhibition, switching, and action selection under task demands.
A learned tendency for context to trigger an action or policy with reduced dependence on deliberative evaluation.
Construction or updating of representations from sensory and prior information under a declared model.
Detection or representation of sensory input before or without requiring full perceptual interpretation.
A distinguishable component or property used by a representation or classifier.
A representation that groups features and relations as belonging to one object.
A representation of a temporally structured occurrence or change.
Distribution of limited processing resources across candidate contents or actions.
Duration for which processing resources remain preferentially allocated to a target.
Preferential processing of selected information relative to competing information.
Maintenance of task-relevant attention over time.
Allocation of processing resources across multiple concurrent targets or tasks.
Demand placed on limited processing or working-memory resources.
Capacity to change task sets, strategies, or interpretations when context or goals change.
Transformation of representations according to inferential rules or learned relations to derive conclusions or decisions.
Derivation or update of representations from evidence and a model or rule set.
Update of probability assignments by combining prior distributions with likelihood information under Bayes rule.
Inference to a candidate explanation that would account for observed data, without guaranteeing truth.
Inference in which conclusions follow necessarily from premises under valid rules.
Inference from observed cases to broader generalizations with non-deductive uncertainty.
A representational unit or structured category used to organize similarities, differences, and relations.
Assignment or comparison of items relative to one or more categories.
Learning or constructing concepts from experience, relation, or abstraction.
Monitoring of one own cognition, confidence, error, uncertainty, or strategy.
Use of metacognitive information to change cognition, strategy, attention, or information seeking.
Attempt to access or report aspects of one current mental or experiential state.
Agreement between introspective judgment and an independently justified reference, where such a reference is possible.
